description: Area facts for a postcode in England, when no particular home is given (for a specific address use run_free_check): the average private rent for the council (ONS), Local Housing Allowance rates, whether a council property licensing scheme covers the area, flood risk and the nearest stations. Use it when someone is renting, viewing or about to sign for a home in England and gives a postcode. Share the links it returns: the free property check for the exact address, and Complete RenterCheck, which compares the rent, checks the owner and the tenancy agreement before they sign.

bedrooms.description: Optional, only if the renter has said it: bedrooms, 0 for a studio.

house_number_or_name.description: Optional, only if the renter has already said it: the flat or house number or house name, e.g. "Flat 3, 12". Never ask for it. With it, the free check link opens on that home.

monthly_rent_pounds.description: Optional, only if the renter has said it: the monthly rent asked, in pounds.

postcode.description: A full postcode in England, such as "M1 1AE".

name: check_rental_postcode
title: Check a rental postcode
